title: Who's at the Door?
hook: The wolf can copy a voice and fake a white foot. Can you find the clue he can't copy?

fa.title: کیه پشتِ در؟
fa.hook: گرگ می‌تواند صدا را تقلید کند و پایش را سفید کند. می‌توانی سرنخی را پیدا کنی که او نمی‌تواند تقلید کند؟

veo.style: Animate this hand-painted children's picture-book illustration in exactly its own style: gouache texture and paper grain stay, soft colours, gentle natural movement like a lovingly made 2D animated film. Keep every character's face, fur, colours and proportions exactly as in the picture; no new characters appear, and every character appears only once. No one talks; mouths stay mostly closed. Static camera unless told otherwise.
veo.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, speech, distorted faces, extra limbs, morphing, photorealistic, 3D render, scary, sharp teeth, blood, dark

clips.motion: The mother goat with the blue headscarf waves goodbye with one hoof, turns and walks slowly away down the path with her basket; the three little kids wave from the doorway and their bells jingle. Static camera.

lines.en: I must go and find grass. Lock the door, and open it only for me.
lines.fa: من باید بروم علف پیدا کنم. در را قفل کنید و فقط برای من باز کنید.

lines.en: Remember: I have a soft voice and white feet. And only I know our secret song.
lines.fa: یادتان باشد: صدای من نرم است و پاهایم سفید. و فقط من آهنگِ رازمان را بلدم.

clips.motion: The closed blue wooden door shakes a little three times, as if someone outside is knocking; the three little kids jump, their ears go up and they huddle together, staring at the door. The door stays closed the whole time. Static camera.
The grey cartoon wolf gulps a big wooden spoonful of golden honey, smacks his lips happily and clears his throat, looking very pleased with himself. Static camera, comic.

lines.en: The wolf ate a big spoon of honey, to make his voice soft and sweet.
lines.fa: گرگ یک قاشقِ بزرگ عسل خورد تا صدایش نرم و شیرین شود.

clips.motion: A big black furry paw slowly slides in under the closed blue door and wiggles its toes; the three little kids lean in to look, then point at it. Static camera.
The grey cartoon wolf dips both front paws into the big sack of white flour; a soft white cloud puffs up and he sneezes comically, then admires his white paws. Static camera.

lines.en: Then the wolf ran to the baker, and rubbed his feet in white flour.
lines.fa: بعد گرگ دوید پیشِ نانوا و پاهایش را توی آردِ سفید مالید.

clips.motion: The blue door stays firmly shut and does not move or open at all. Only at the very bottom, a big paw covered in white flour slowly slides in through the narrow gap under the closed door, leaving a little dusting of flour on the floor; the three little goat kids lean in and look at it, surprised. Static camera.

Outside the blue door the grey cartoon wolf tries to sing: he opens his mouth, hums, coughs, waves a paw like a conductor and sings badly; two little birds on the roof cover their ears with their wings. Static camera, comic.

The grey cartoon wolf stomps off grumpily along the path into the woods, little puffs of flour coming off his feet, and disappears between the trees; the three little kids peek out of the window and giggle. Static camera.

lines.en: The wolf was so cross that he ran far into the woods, and he never came back.
lines.fa: گرگ آن‌قدر عصبانی شد که دوید و رفت توی جنگل، و دیگر هیچ‌وقت برنگشت.

clips.motion: The mother goat with the blue headscarf gently nuzzles her three little goat kids in the doorway; they snuggle closer, their tails wag and their bells jingle; warm golden sunset light. All four stay goats exactly as in the picture. Static camera.

lines.en: My clever kids! How did you know it was really me?
lines.fa: بچه‌های باهوشم! از کجا فهمیدید که واقعاً خودم هستم؟

lines.en: A voice can be copied. A white foot can be faked. But nobody else knows our song!
lines.fa: صدا را می‌شود تقلید کرد. پای سفید را می‌شود ساختگی درست کرد. ولی هیچ‌کس دیگر آهنگِ ما را بلد نیست!

clips.motion: The blue door opens just a crack and the grey cartoon wolf's long nose pokes in, sniffing; the three little kids squeal, then all push the door shut together with a bump, and the nose pops back out. Silly and funny, not scary. Static camera.

ask-song.en: Here is our secret song. Can you play it back on the bells?
ask-song.fa: این آهنگِ رازِ ماست. می‌توانی با زنگوله‌ها دوباره بزنی‌اش؟

r-song-miss.fa: نزدیک بود! یک بارِ دیگر گوش کن.

r-song.en: Perfect! Never tell it to anyone.
r-song.fa: عالی بود! هیچ‌وقت آن را به کسی نگو.

door-rough.en: Open the door, my dears. It's your mother!
door-rough.fa: در را باز کنید، عزیزانم. مادرتان هستم!

ask-door.en: Someone is at the door! What will you do?
ask-door.fa: یک نفر پشتِ در است! چه کار می‌کنی؟

r-rough.en: That voice is rough and loud. Mother's voice is soft. You're the wolf!
r-rough.fa: این صدا زبر و بلند است. صدای مادر نرم است. تو گرگی!

r-oops.en: Oops! Never open the door before you check. Let's go back!
r-oops.fa: اوه! هیچ‌وقت قبل از بررسی در را باز نکن. برگردیم عقب!

door-sweet.en: Open the door, my dears. It's your mother!
door-sweet.fa: در را باز کنید، عزیزانم. مادرتان هستم!

r-sweet.en: Hmm. That sounds just like Mother. What else can we check?
r-sweet.fa: هوم. درست مثلِ صدای مادر است. دیگر چه چیزی را می‌شود بررسی کرد؟

r-black.en: A black foot! Mother has white feet. You're the wolf!
r-black.fa: پای سیاه! پاهای مادر سفید است. تو گرگی!

door-sweet2.en: It's me, my dears! Look, my feet are white!
door-sweet2.fa: خودمم، عزیزانم! نگاه کنید، پاهایم سفید است!

r-white.en: A white foot, just like Mother's. But the wolf tricked us before. What can't he copy?
r-white.fa: پای سفید، درست مثلِ پای مادر. ولی گرگ قبلاً هم ما را گول زد. چه چیزی را نمی‌تواند تقلید کند؟

r-asksong.en: If you are our mother, sing our secret song!
r-asksong.fa: اگر مادرِ ما هستی، آهنگِ رازمان را بخوان!

ask-wolfsong.en: Listen carefully. Is that our song?
ask-wolfsong.fa: خوب گوش کن. این آهنگِ ماست؟

r-wolfsong-yes.en: Listen again: those are not our notes!
r-wolfsong-yes.fa: دوباره گوش کن: این‌ها نت‌های ما نیستند!

r-wolfsong-no.en: That's not our song! You're the wolf! Go away!
r-wolfsong-no.fa: این آهنگِ ما نیست! تو گرگی! برو پی کارت!

ask-why.en: Why was the song the best clue?

r-why-right.en: Yes! Only Mother knows it. A clue that can't be copied is the one to trust.
r-why-right.fa: آفرین! فقط مادر آن را بلد است. سرنخی که نمی‌شود تقلیدش کرد، قابلِ اعتماد است.

r-why-wrong.en: Hmm. Think again: could the wolf copy it?
r-why-wrong.fa: هوم. دوباره فکر کن: گرگ می‌توانست تقلیدش کند؟

door-mother.en: My dears, it's me. Listen to our song!
door-mother.fa: عزیزانم، خودمم. به آهنگمان گوش کنید!

r-mothersong-no.en: Listen again. Those are our notes!
r-mothersong-no.fa: دوباره گوش کن. این‌ها نت‌های خودِ ما هستند!

r-mothersong-yes.en: It's our song! It's really Mother!
r-mothersong-yes.fa: آهنگِ خودمان است! واقعاً مادر است!

teaser.en: Next case: Max says kids with bigger feet read better. Is he right?
teaser.fa: پرونده‌ی بعدی: کیان می‌گوید بچه‌هایی که پای بزرگ‌تری دارند بهتر کتاب می‌خوانند. حق با اوست؟

q.en: Someone is at the door again!
q.fa: باز یک نفر پشتِ در است!

q.en: A soft voice… and a white foot?
Why was the song the best clue?

t.en: Only Mother knows it, so it can't be copied
t.fa: فقط مادر بلدش است، پس نمی‌شود تقلیدش کرد

title.en: A clue that can't be faked

explorers.en: Some clues can be copied, like a voice or a white foot. Check the clue nobody else can copy.
explorers.fa: بعضی سرنخ‌ها را می‌شود تقلید کرد، مثلِ صدا یا پای سفید. سرنخی را بررسی کن که هیچ‌کس دیگر نمی‌تواند تقلیدش کند.

investigators.en: Good evidence is hard to fake. Before you believe, ask: could someone copy this clue?
investigators.fa: شاهدِ خوب سخت جعل می‌شود. پیش از باور کردن بپرس: کسی می‌تواند این سرنخ را تقلید کند؟

t.en: Next case: the big feet mystery
